title: Whole Twin Arch Fenders and Bollards Quay Front Scene

Both complete flange backs touch the quay front, and both whole bollard feet have finite opposed areas on the top. Original fender wear pads, both horns and all four original bollard fastener details remain unchanged. Complete original qualified GLB bytes and full generators are embedded with exact hashes; only whole proper rigid transforms and new scene-only quay and pegs are authored here. This is a dry static illustrative component arrangement, not a complete port or operating berth. No rope, water, vessel, cargo equipment, water-level assumption, collision behaviour or animation. Finite contacts and selected interior roots describe the visual geometry only: no real mounting standard, pad bonding, anchorage design, elastic response, fender energy absorption, mooring or vessel compatibility, load transfer, installation, durability or maritime/structural safety capability certified. Original component limitations remain; no part of an older scene or old model was cropped, remeshed or recoloured.
